extra.message: SQL injection: the X-Payment-Ref request header value (ref) is concatenated directly into the SQL string 'select ... where reference like ''%"+ref+"%'' ...' which is then executed with Statement.executeQuery. An attacker can supply a crafted reference such as '%'' OR 1=1--' to alter the query and read arbitrary payment rows.

cwe: CWE-89: SQL Injection

extra.message: OGNL expression injection: the user-supplied 'rule' request parameter is passed straight to ognl.Ognl.getValue(rule, vars, vars). OGNL allows arbitrary method calls and class instantiation, so an authenticated bank-ops caller can achieve remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: Broken access control / IDOR: note() loads the payment by id globally and only enforces the company check when the attacker-supplied companyId is non-null. Omitting companyId (or sending null) lets any authenticated user write an amendment note onto any other company's payment.

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: LDAP injection: the client-supplied commonName is concatenated into the LDAP search filter '(&(objectClass=person)(cn="+commonName+"))'. An attacker can inject filter syntax such as ')(|(uid=*' to bypass the intended filter and enumerate or modify directory queries.

cwe: CWE-90: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')

extra.message: XML External Entity (XXE) injection: DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance() is left at its insecure defaults (no FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING, disallow-doctype-decl or external-entity disabling) before parsing attacker-controlled XML from the request. External entities can be used for file disclosure, SSRF and denial of service.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: XPath injection: the accountRef request value is concatenated into the XPath expression '//Ntry[AcctSvcrRef='"+accountRef+"']' and evaluated against the parsed document. A value such as "' or '1'='1" or "'] | //* | //*['" changes the query and exposes nodes the caller should not access.

cwe: CWE-643: Improper Neutralization of Data within XPath Expressions ('XPath Injection')

extra.message: Path traversal (arbitrary file write): the fileName request value is only length-limited by req(), then used as new File(reportRoot.toFile(), name). A value such as '../../../../tmp/evil.sh' escapes reportRoot and writes attacker-controlled content outside the intended directory. cleanName() is used elsewhere but not here.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: OS command injection: the user-controlled sourceAddress is concatenated into a single shell command string passed to new ProcessBuilder("cmd","/c","wkhtmltopdf "+source+" "+out). Shell metacharacters in sourceAddress allow arbitrary command execution (e.g. 'x & calc'). Arguments must be passed as separate list elements, not one string.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')

extra.message: Server-side template injection: the raw request parameter body is passed to Velocity.evaluate(ctx, w, "noticePreview", body). Velocity can invoke arbitrary methods on Java objects in the context and class loaders, leading to remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: JWT signature is never verified: partnerNotice() calls SignedJWT.parse(assertion) and immediately trusts getJWTClaimsSet().getSubject() with no verify()/JWSVerifier call. Anyone can forge an unsigned/arbitrary JWT to impersonate any partner user and post notes onto another company's payments.

cwe: CWE-347: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature

extra.message: Insecure deserialization: a Base64 'savedBatch' request value is decoded and passed to ObjectInputStream.readObject(). The SavedBatch type is attacker-influenced and Java serialization gadgets can be triggered, resulting in remote code execution.

cwe: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data

extra.message: FreeMarker server-side template injection: a stored advice template body (from decision.advice_templates) is compiled directly with new freemarker.template.Template(name, body, cfg) and processed. If a template such as '${...?new(...)}' is stored, the render endpoint executes it, allowing code execution.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

extra.message: Server-Side Request Forgery: the url request parameter is used directly as callbackClient.get().uri(url) in callbackProbe(). An authenticated company admin can force the server to request internal addresses (e.g. http://169.254.169.254/... or http://localhost:8082) and observe status/length metadata.

cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

extra.message: Missing state-machine enforcement / broken business authorization: statusCorr() assigns Domain.PaymentStatus.valueOf(b.get('status')) directly to the payment without consulting the StateMachines transition table or validating against the current status. Any bank-ops caller can move a payment to arbitrary states (e.g. RELEASED, REVERSED) bypassing workflow controls.

cwe: CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization

extra.message: Hardcoded default cryptographic key: the AES envelope key falls back to @Value('${app.callback-envelope-key:northstar-callback-2025}'), so any deployment without the environment override uses a publicly known key, allowing attackers to forge or decrypt callback envelopes.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: Server-Side Request Forgery: callbackCheck() takes the target request parameter and performs partnerClient.get().uri(destination) with no allow-list or address validation. An authenticated user can make the portal probe internal services and infer responses.

cwe: CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

extra.message: Path traversal (arbitrary file write): the letterhead upload builds Path target=uploadBase.resolve(givenName).normalize() from the multipart original filename without checking target.startsWith(uploadBase), then Files.copy() writes there. A filename like '../../../../etc/cron.d/x' escapes the upload directory.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: Stored cross-site scripting: noticeBoard() concatenates notification title/body values read from the database straight into an HTML string returned with Content-Type text/html, with no escaping. A notice body containing '<script>...' executes in the browser of any user viewing /notices/board.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: Path traversal (arbitrary file read): openAdvice() does Files.readString(uploadBase.resolve(ref)) using the raw X-Advice-Ref request header. No normalization or containment check is performed, so '../' sequences read arbitrary files on the host.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: Path traversal (arbitrary file read): report() resolves the raw report request parameter with uploadBase.resolve(report) and streams it with Files.newInputStream without verifying the result stays inside uploadBase. '../' traversal exposes arbitrary host files.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')

extra.message: Hardcoded default cryptographic key: the statement AES key defaults to @Value('${app.statement-key:northstar-legacy-statement-2024}'). Deployments that do not set app.statement-key use a known key, and openReference() then decrypts attacker-supplied ciphertext with it.

cwe: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials

extra.message: Privilege escalation via mass assignment: the profile POST binds the client-controlled ProfileFields.role (and overrides it from the attacker-forgeable ns_profile_draft cookie) and writes it with 'update portal.users set display_name=?,job_title=?,role=coalesce(?,role)'. A low-privileged user can update their own role to COMPANY_ADMIN or BANK_ADMIN.

cwe: CWE-269: Improper Privilege Management

extra.message: Open redirect: the invite acceptance handler redirects to 'redirect:'+destination where destination is the user-supplied 'onward' request parameter, with no validation. An attacker can craft an invitation link that redirects the freshly authenticated user to an external site (phishing/token theft).

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: Sensitive information in logs: the invite handler logs the raw invitation token (LOG.info("... reference "+token)). Anyone with log access can replay the token to accept the invitation and set the account password.

cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

extra.message: Insufficiently random authentication token: deskPass() mints the desk pass as "NS-DESK-"+branch+"-"+DESK_SEQUENCE.incrementAndGet(), a predictable incrementing counter starting at 1000. deskClaim() authenticates solely on this value, so an attacker who obtains one pass can guess others and hijack sessions.

cwe: CWE-330: Use of Insufficiently Random Values

extra.message: Sensitive data exposure: the verification() endpoint returns the freshly generated step-up code in the HTTP response ("verificationCode", code). Returning the secret defeats the out-of-band verification control entirely.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

extra.message: Weak password hashing: legacySignIn() verifies the user password using MD5 (DigestUtils.md5DigestAsHex) against an unsalted MD5 digest stored in portal.legacy_credentials. MD5 is fast and broken, enabling offline brute-force/rainbow-table recovery of credentials.

cwe: CWE-916: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort

extra.message: Weak credential hashing: consolePass() stores the console passphrase as an unsalted SHA-1 digest (MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-1")) in portal.console_credentials, and the same digest is later used for authentication in consoleOpen(). SHA-1 is unsuitable for password storage.

cwe: CWE-916: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort

extra.message: Permissive CORS configuration: portalCors() maps /documents/** with allowedOriginPatterns("*") together with allowCredentials(true). Any website can make credentialed cross-origin requests to document endpoints and read the responses, enabling data theft.

cwe: CWE-942: Permissive Cross-domain Policy with Untrusted Domains

extra.message: Clickjacking protection disabled: the security filter chain calls headers(hd->hd.frameOptions(fo->fo.disable())), removing X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors so the portal can be embedded in an attacker-controlled iframe and clickjacked.

cwe: CWE-1021: Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames

extra.message: Information disclosure through directory listing: the legacy Tomcat DefaultServlet is registered with listings=true (and /legacy/** is permitAll in PortalSecurity), so anonymous users can browse and enumerate all files under the upload directory.

cwe: CWE-548: Exposure of Information Through Directory Listing

extra.message: Session ID tracking via URL: sessionTracking() sets SessionTrackingMode.URL, embedding the JSESSIONID in URLs. Session identifiers can leak through Referer headers, logs and bookmarks, enabling session hijacking.

cwe: CWE-598: Use of GET Request Method With Sensitive Query Strings

extra.message: Sensitive actuator exposure: /actuator/** is permitAll in the payment-api SecurityConfig while the management endpoints expose env, heapdump, beans and threaddump and env.show-values is ALWAYS. Unauthenticated attackers can retrieve environment secrets and heap dumps.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
